offerte.photoGuideTitle: Photo tips — how to take the best photos
offerte.photoGuideIntro: Our AI automatically analyses your photos for quality. Follow these tips for the fastest and most accurate quote.
offerte.photoGuideTip1: Take photos in daylight. Make sure the damage is well-lit and clearly visible.
offerte.photoGuideTip2: Take multiple photos from different angles: front, side, and close-up.
offerte.photoGuideTip3: Take a close-up of the damage so scratches, dents, and paint damage are clearly visible.
offerte.photoGuideTip4: Avoid dark or poorly lit photos. The damage is not visible without sufficient light.
offerte.photoGuideTip5: Don't stand too far away. The damage must be clearly recognisable, not a tiny dot in the distance.
offerte.photoGuideTip6: Make sure the photo is sharp. Blurry or shaky photos make it impossible to assess the damage.
offerte.photoGuideNote: Tip: use your phone's rear camera for the best quality. Our AI checks each photo for lighting, sharpness, angle, distance, and damage visibility.

kras.metaDesc: Professional scratch repair in Rotterdam. Paint scratch restoration, spot repair and painting by specialists.
kras.title: Scratch Repair
kras.intro: A scratch on your car? From light surface scratches to deep scratches through the paint — we expertly repair them all.
kras.whatDesc: Scratches are caused by contact with sharp objects, branches, keys or parking lot accidents. They range from surface scratches in the clear coat to deep scratches down to the metal.
kras.howDesc: Depending on the depth, we use spot repair, polishing or partial respray. With our spectrophotometer we match the exact colour for an invisible result.
kras.ctaDesc: Request a quote directly or make an appointment for a free inspection.

deuk.metaDesc: Professional dent repair in Rotterdam. PDR, paintless dent removal and bodywork restoration.
deuk.title: Dent Repair
deuk.intro: Dents in your car? From small parking dents to large dents — we have the solution.
deuk.whatDesc: Dents are caused by parking accidents, shopping carts, hailstorms or collisions. They range from small dents without paint damage to large deformations.
deuk.howDesc: For small dents without paint damage we use PDR (Paintless Dent Repair). For larger dents we apply bodywork repair followed by professional paintwork.
deuk.ctaDesc: Request a quote directly or make an appointment for an inspection.

lakschade.metaTitle: Paint Damage Repair | Colourking Auto Body
lakschade.metaDesc: Professional paint damage repair in Rotterdam. Paint restoration, respraying and colour matching.
lakschade.title: Paint Damage Repair
lakschade.intro: Paint damage from weathering, stone chips or chemicals? We restore your paint to original quality.
lakschade.whatDesc: Paint damage includes peeling paint, UV discolouration, chemical stains, stone chips and rust formation. Left untreated, this leads to further deterioration.
lakschade.howTitle: How do we repair paint damage?
lakschade.howDesc: We sand, prime and spray the damaged area with exactly matched paint. For severe damage we perform a full panel or vehicle respray.
lakschade.ctaDesc: Our specialists restore your paint to factory-new condition. Request a quote now.

bumper.metaDesc: Professional bumper repair in Rotterdam. Bumper damage, cracks and scratches expertly repaired.
bumper.title: Bumper Repair
bumper.intro: Damaged bumper? From cracks and scratches to deformations — we repair bumpers of all brands.
bumper.whatDesc: Bumper damage often occurs from parking bumps, collisions or curbs. Modern bumpers are plastic and can crack, scratch or deform.
bumper.howDesc: We repair plastic bumpers with special welding and filling, followed by filler work and professional painting. This is often cheaper than replacement.
bumper.ctaDesc: Often cheaper than replacement. Request a quote for bumper repair now.

hagel.metaTitle: Hail Damage Repair | Colourking Auto Body
hagel.metaDesc: Professional hail damage repair in Rotterdam. PDR, paintless dent removal for hail damage.
hagel.title: Hail Damage Repair
hagel.intro: Hail damage to your car? Our PDR specialists efficiently remove hail damage while preserving your original paint.
hagel.whatDesc: Hail damage consists of tens to hundreds of small dents caused by hailstones. The paint usually remains intact, but the dents are clearly visible.
hagel.howTitle: How do we repair hail damage?
hagel.howDesc: With PDR (Paintless Dent Repair) we remove hail damage without needing to repaint. This saves time and costs and preserves the original factory paint.
hagel.ctaDesc: PDR is the fastest and most affordable solution. Request a quote now.

faq.metaDesc: Answers to frequently asked questions about damage repair, insurance, techniques, costs and the repair process at Colour King Rotterdam.
faq.title: How can we help you?
faq.subtitle: Find answers to the most common questions about our bodyshop. Can't find what you're looking for? Don't hesitate to contact us.
faq.catGeneral_q1: What services does Colour King offer?
faq.catGeneral_a1: We specialise in damage repair, paintwork, paintless dent removal (PDR), spot repair, bumper repair, paint restoration and full resprays. Whether it's a small scratch or major collision damage, we provide a suitable solution.
faq.catGeneral_q2: How long does a repair take?
faq.catGeneral_a2: The turnaround time depends on the extent of the damage. Small repairs such as spot repair or a scratch are usually completed within 1 to 2 working days. Larger repairs or paintwork take an average of 3 to 5 working days. We always provide a time estimate with your quote.
faq.catGeneral_q3: Do you offer a warranty on your work?
faq.catGeneral_a3: Yes, all our work comes with a warranty. This applies to both bodywork and paintwork. Should you notice anything after the repair, we will resolve it free of charge.
faq.catGeneral_a4: We are open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 17:30. On Saturdays we are available by appointment. You can always schedule an appointment online via our website.
faq.catGeneral_a5: Our shop is located at Satijnbloem 6, 3068 JP Rotterdam. We are easily accessible from the greater Rotterdam area. Free parking is available directly at our premises.
faq.catInsurance_q1: How does an insurance claim work?
faq.catInsurance_a1: We take care of everything for you. After the inspection, we assess the damage, prepare a quote and submit it to your insurer. We handle all correspondence with the insurance company so you don't have to worry about anything.
faq.catInsurance_q2: Do you work with all insurers?
faq.catInsurance_a2: Yes, we work with all Dutch insurance companies, including Centraal Beheer, Univé, Interpolis, FBTO, Allianz and more. Regardless of your insurer, we are happy to help.
faq.catInsurance_a3: You pay the deductible directly to us. The exact amount is stated in your insurance policy. We inform you in advance about what to expect, so there are no surprises.
faq.catInsurance_q4: What documents do I need for an insurance claim?
faq.catInsurance_a4: You need a damage report from your insurer, your policy number and a valid form of ID. Optionally a police report for collision damage. We help you gather all the necessary documents.
faq.catInsurance_q5: Can you help with filing the claim?
faq.catInsurance_a5: Absolutely. We guide you from start to finish through the claim process. From filling in the damage form to communicating with your insurer — we arrange everything for you.
faq.catTechniques_a1: PDR stands for Paintless Dent Removal. Using special tools, dents are pushed out from the inside without damaging the original paint. This is faster, cheaper and better for your car's value.
faq.catTechniques_a2: PDR is suitable for small to medium dents where the paint is undamaged. Think of parking dents, hail damage or dents from shopping trolleys. For dents with paint damage or on sharp edges, conventional repair is needed.
faq.catTechniques_q3: What's the difference between spot repair and a full respray?
faq.catTechniques_a3: With spot repair, we only repair the damaged area without painting the entire panel. This is faster and more affordable. A full respray is needed for more extensive damage or when the colour needs to be renewed across the whole panel.
faq.catTechniques_a4: We use an advanced spectrophotometer that scans the exact colour code of your car. With this, we mix the paint to a perfect match so the repair is invisible — even with metallic and pearl finishes.
faq.catTechniques_q5: Do you work on all car brands?
faq.catTechniques_a5: Yes, we work on all car brands and models, from city cars to premium marques. Our specialists have experience with a wide range of body types and paint finishes.
faq.catCosts_a1: The price is based on a thorough damage assessment. We examine the extent of the damage, the materials needed and the labour time. You receive a detailed quote so you know exactly what to expect.
faq.catCosts_a2: Yes, our quotes are always free and non-binding. You can request a quote via our online form, by phone or by visiting us for an inspection.
faq.catCosts_q3: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.catCosts_a3: You can pay by debit card, bank transfer or via our online payment platform (Mollie). With invoicing, you receive a payment link for easy and secure online payment.
faq.catCosts_q4: Do you offer lease or fleet pricing?
faq.catCosts_a4: Yes, we offer special rates for leasing companies and fleets. Contact us for a tailored quote. We are happy to discuss structural collaboration.
faq.catCosts_a5: No, at Colour King there are no hidden costs. The quote you receive is the final price. Should additional work be needed during the repair, we always discuss this with you beforehand.
faq.catProcess_q1: What happens after I submit the form?
faq.catProcess_a1: After receiving your enquiry, we contact you within 24 hours. We discuss the damage, schedule an inspection if needed and prepare a quote.
faq.catProcess_q2: Can I track my repair progress?
faq.catProcess_a2: Yes, we keep you informed about the progress via email and phone. At key milestones, such as the start of the repair and the completion notification, you receive an automatic update.
faq.catProcess_a3: Yes, replacement transport is available on request. We discuss this when scheduling your repair, so you won't be left without a car.
faq.catProcess_a4: Yes, for customers in the Rotterdam area we offer a pickup and delivery service. We collect your car and return it after the repair, so you don't need to travel.
faq.catProcess_q5: How do I request a quote?
faq.catProcess_a5: You can easily request a quote via our online form on the website, by phone or by visiting us. Upload photos of the damage for a faster assessment.
faq.ctaDesc: Feel free to contact us. We are happy to help you personally with all your questions about damage repair.
